purpose: Test the repository's Leptos applications against the newest published stable 0.8 patch release without changing the pinned benchmark baseline or conflating framework migration with frontend-agent quality.

candidate.upstream_release_note: HydrationScripts defer option and backport of PR #4964.

excluded_experiments.reason: Do not combine prerelease compatibility experiments with the stable patch-upgrade gate.

constraints: Do not alter the pinned 0.8.20 benchmark baseline.
Use a separate branch or isolated worktree for the 0.8.23 lockfile update.
Do not change frontend source code during the dependency-only compatibility pass unless a concrete API or build defect is reproduced.
Record the exact Rust toolchain, Cargo.lock diff and resolved Leptos subcrate versions.
Keep CSR, SSR and hydration requirements separate; the initial bridge baselines are CSR.

verification_sequence.oracle: cargo tree -i leptos shows 0.8.23 for each selected bridge surface; no unexpected Leptos 0.9 prerelease is resolved.
Only expected dependency resolution changes are present; capture exact diff and lockfile digest.

verification_sequence.command: cargo fmt --check -p symthaea-ui -p symthaea-web -p symthaea-muse-ui && cargo clippy -p symthaea-ui -p symthaea-web -p symthaea-muse-ui --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
verification_sequence.oracle: Formatting and Clippy pass without lint suppression or changed project gates.

verification_sequence.command: cargo test -p symthaea-ui && cargo test -p symthaea-web && cargo test -p symthaea-muse-ui
verification_sequence.oracle: All package tests pass on the exact 0.8.23 candidate lockfile.

verification_sequence.command: trunk build --release (from each selected CSR app directory)
verification_sequence.oracle: All selected CSR applications build with the pinned toolchain and no unexpected WASM size or dependency regression.

verification_sequence.command: cargo test -p symthaea-browser --test frontend_capture_smoke -- --ignored --nocapture; then capture fixed viewport fixtures in all three apps
verification_sequence.oracle: Browser capture, routing, chat, Muse playback persistence and telemetry state transitions behave as before.

verification_sequence.command: Compare pinned browser captures and WASM artefacts against 0.8.20 baseline.
verification_sequence.oracle: No critical visual/functional regression; report cold-load, interaction latency, compressed WASM size and Core Web Vitals as separate measures.

acceptance_gates: All compiler, Clippy, test and WASM build gates pass on the exact candidate head.
No existing required browser journey regresses.
The source-observed contract and SFEB task manifests remain valid.
No accessibility or security hard gate regresses.
All measurements identify the resolved framework and lockfile version.
notes: The 0.8.23 release note primarily concerns HydrationScripts and a backport; its direct effect on the current CSR bridge applications may be limited. This is a testable expectation, not an assumption.
No 0.8.23 build or compatibility result has been measured yet.
The benchmark baseline remains Leptos 0.8.20 until this experiment is independently qualified and a deliberate baseline version bump is reviewed.
